summary: 87/102 confirms existing III.1 herausarbeiten in a conditional Infectum clause: monetary theme alfo=waroqe, recipient -xu and monthly rate b-u=yarḥo. No new example is added because this same passage is already quoted.

The benefactive/recipient suffix does not create a new earning sense or a light-verb construction. The lexical verb itself takes the monetary object; the source alone does not settle produce versus earn beyond the inherited gloss.
The inherited Arabic-origin etymology and base forms are retained. No wider productive or figurative sense is inferred from a single already-cited occurrence.

rationale: Tausend modifies Pfundnoten as a cardinal number and must be lowercase here. The supplied translation of 87/102 reads im Monat tausend Pfundnoten.
